entries.sense_en: people who regularly live in or spend time in a place
entries.sense_ko: 그곳에 늘 살거나 드나드는 사람들, 단골 주민

synonyms.nuance: Neutral, official: anyone who lives in a place. Has no humorous or literary flavor.
Slightly formal; stresses living in a place, often of a whole region or country.
Casual: someone who often visits a place, not necessarily living there.

entries.sense_en: a visiting card, made of stiff paper (old slang)

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word; can be a business, greeting or playing card.
Thick brown packing material, not a visiting card.

entries.sense_en: fully aware of something

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and much more common; the natural choice in speech.
synonyms.example: I was aware of the noise.

synonyms.nuance: Stresses noticing something in your own mind, often a feeling or effect.
Suggests keeping something in mind on purpose and acting with care.

entries.tip_ko: 격식 있는 단어라 일상 대화에서는 aware를 주로 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: making you feel sleepy, calm and lazy

synonyms.nuance: Describes a person who feels tired, or a quiet place; not what causes sleep.
Medical: calming or sleep-inducing, usually a drug.
Describes the half-asleep feeling itself, not what causes it.

entries.sense_en: the cold north wind (named after the Greek god of the north wind)

synonyms.nuance: Plain, everyday term for the same cold wind.
A short spell of very cold weather, not a wind.

entries.sense_en: police officers, named after their blue uniform coats

synonyms.nuance: Informal American slang for a police officer, used throughout the story.
Neutral, standard word.
Polite or official; also used when speaking to the police.

entries.sense_en: pleasant because the people are friendly and like the same things

synonyms.nuance: Simple and general; describes a person's manner, not how well people fit together.
Pleasant to deal with; a bit formal.
Describes two people or things that work well together, often technical or about relationships.

entries.sense_en: a journey made to escape a bad place; here, Soapy's yearly trip to jail

synonyms.nuance: A large group leaving a place together.
synonyms.example: the summer exodus from the city

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for hurried escape; carries no ceremony.
Regular seasonal movement of people or animals, like Soapy's winter trip.

entries.tip_ko: 원래 무함마드의 메카 탈출을 가리키는 말이다. 여기서는 겨울마다 감옥으로 '피난'을 가는 것을 익살스럽게 부풀린 표현이다.

entries.sense_en: to drive back or keep away

synonyms.nuance: More common; to push away or keep out, also used for smells and insects.
Phrasal verb; to defend yourself against an attack, question or unwanted thing.
Plain phrase, often of an army pushing an enemy away.

entries.tip_ko: 'repulsive(역겨운)'와 연결되지만, 여기서는 '막아내다'라는 뜻이다.

entries.sense_en: given or run as charity

synonyms.nuance: Common everyday word for kindness to the poor.
Suggests large-scale, organized giving, often by rich people.
Stresses the kind wish to do good; somewhat formal.

entries.tip_ko: 매우 어렵고 격식 있는 단어다. 법률·문어체에서 자선 단체를 가리킬 때 쓰인다.

entries.sense_en: kind and gentle; not harsh

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for a caring person.
Soft and not rough; can describe people, animals or touch.
Not able to cause damage; often used for objects or situations.

entries.tip_ko: 의학에서는 '양성(良性)의'라는 뜻이다. 반대말은 malignant(악성).

entries.sense_en: loaded down with a burden or hidden cost
entries.sense_ko: 부담이 딸린, 짐이 되는 조건이 붙은

synonyms.nuance: Common; to load with a heavy duty or worry.
To slow or make something harder to do.
Phrasal verb; to burden in a physical or emotional sense.

entries.modern: "gifts are encumbered" → "gifts come with strings attached"

entries.sense_en: for that reason; therefore

synonyms.nuance: Standard formal word for a result or conclusion.
synonyms.example: It rained; therefore we stayed home.

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and much less formal.
synonyms.example: It rained, so we stayed home.

synonyms.nuance: Formal; leads into a result and is shorter than therefore.
synonyms.example: He is ill; hence his absence.

entries.tip_ko: 'Wherefore art thou Romeo?'의 wherefore는 '왜(why)'라는 뜻이다. 여기서는 '그러므로'라는 뜻이다.

entries.sense_en: to get involved in other people's affairs without being asked

synonyms.nuance: General: to get in the way of something; less personal than meddle.
To ask questions about private matters out of curiosity.
Informal; to interrupt a conversation or activity rudely.

entries.tip_ko: meddle in/with + 남의 일 형태로 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: to reject something as unworthy, with contempt

synonyms.nuance: Strong dislike for someone or something you think is bad or low.
Cool superiority; more formal, and often a proud attitude.
To reject an offer or person in a hurtful way.

entries.sense_en: being unable to pay what you owe

synonyms.nuance: Formal legal declaration by a court that you cannot pay; insolvency is the condition.
General lack of money; not about debts specifically.
Informal spoken phrase for having no money at the moment.

entries.sense_en: a local judge who handles minor crimes

synonyms.nuance: General word for the person who decides court cases, including serious ones.
synonyms.example: The judge gave her a fine.

synonyms.nuance: A local, often unpaid officer for minor cases.
synonyms.example: married by a justice of the peace

entries.sense_en: worn and coming apart at the edges

synonyms.nuance: Torn and rough overall, not just at the edges.
Used up by long use; may not be torn.
Cloth so thin you can see through it; suggests poverty.

entries.tip_ko: 'frayed nerves'처럼 신경이 곤두선 상태를 나타낼 때도 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: shabby and in poor condition, as if from decline

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for clothes or places that look old and worn.
Describes a building or area that has been neglected.
Morally or physically declined; a stronger, negative judgment on a person.

entries.tip_ko: 요즘은 '퇴폐적일 만큼 사치스러운'의 뜻으로 많이 쓰인다(decadent dessert). 여기서는 '낡고 초라한'에 가깝다.

entries.sense_en: shameful; not honorable

synonyms.nuance: Common; causing shame or disgrace.
Against the rules of honor; often about conduct.
Lacking the calm respect expected; more about embarrassment than sin.

entries.tip_ko: noble의 반대말이다. 미국식 발음은 /ɪɡˈnoʊbəl/이다.

entries.sense_en: devoted to fine food and pleasure

synonyms.nuance: Only about fine food and drink.
Pursuing pleasure of all kinds; can sound disapproving.
Rich and comfortable; describes things more than people.

entries.tip_ko: 고대 그리스 철학자 에피쿠로스에서 나온 말이다.

entries.sense_en: an in-between place; here, jail as a place to wait out the winter
entries.sense_ko: 중간 상태의 장소, 어정쩡한 곳(여기서는 감옥)

synonyms.nuance: Stronger: a place or time of suffering before something better.
An area belonging to nobody, often between two sides.
Common phrase: stuck in an uncertain state.

entries.tip_ko: in limbo(어중간한 상태)라는 관용구로 자주 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: a rounded stone used to pave old streets
entries.sense_ko: (옛 길에 깔던) 둥근 포장용 돌, 자갈돌

synonyms.nuance: Flat cut stone for pavements; cobblestones are rounder.
A small stone found on a beach; too small to smash a window.

entries.sense_en: to run away quickly

synonyms.nuance: Plain, neutral phrase.
Formal or dramatic; escaping from danger.
Informal; to dash away suddenly, often from capture.
synonyms.example: The thief made a run for it.

entries.sense_en: to stop and talk with an opponent

synonyms.nuance: Standard; to reach an agreement through talking.
Everyday and general; has no sense of enemies or formality.
Formal; to discuss together before deciding.

entries.sense_en: servants who carry out a powerful person's orders (here, the police)

synonyms.nuance: Neutral: someone who serves another.
Lower-ranking worker; slightly scornful.
synonyms.example: He left it to his underlings.

synonyms.nuance: A follower who does dirty work for a criminal or villain.

entries.tip_ko: 요즘은 영화 '미니언즈'로 친숙하지만, 원래는 남에게 휘둘리는 하수인을 얕잡는 말이다.

entries.sense_en: to walk or spend time slowly with nothing to do

synonyms.nuance: To stand around a place with no clear purpose, often suspiciously.
To relax lazily, usually sitting or lying down.
To walk with no fixed direction; not necessarily lazy.

entries.tip_ko: 명사 loaf(빵 한 덩이)와 철자가 같아 헷갈리기 쉽다.

entries.sense_en: hard and unfeeling (here, of the hard pavement)

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for a solid surface or a cold person.
Describes a person who shows no pity.
Fails to notice others' feelings; milder than callous.

entries.tip_ko: callus(굳은살)와 발음이 같고 뜻도 이어진다. 단어에 '굳은살처럼 무감각한'이라는 뜻이 있다.

entries.sense_en: in a silly, self-satisfied way

synonyms.nuance: Plain and neutral: without good sense.
Blunter and harsher than foolishly.
Pleased with yourself in an annoying way; captures the self-satisfaction of fatuous.

entries.sense_en: something very easy; a sure thing

synonyms.nuance: Informal: something that takes very little effort.
Idiom for a very easy task.
synonyms.example: It was a piece of cake.

synonyms.nuance: Stresses certainty of success, not ease.

entries.tip_ko: It's a cinch. 식으로 쓰는 구어체 표현이다.

entries.sense_en: the way a person looks and behaves

synonyms.nuance: How someone speaks and acts toward others.
How someone holds themselves, often dignified or military.
Inner opinion or feeling toward something, rather than outward look.

entries.sense_en: a man who bothers women with unwelcome flirting (old slang)

synonyms.nuance: Milder; playful attention, not always unwelcome.
Modern slang for someone who makes others uncomfortable.
Dated slang: a man who chases women.

entries.sense_en: hated and cursed by everyone

synonyms.nuance: Plain word; less strong than execrated.
Strong dislike, formal.
Feeling of horror and disgust; strongest.

entries.sense_en: being very close or touching

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for small distance.
Formal: being near in space or time.
synonyms.example: in close proximity to the station

synonyms.nuance: Technical: sitting right next to something.
synonyms.example: the adjacency of the two rooms

entries.modern: "the contiguity of the cop" → "the cop being so close"

entries.sense_en: to move sideways slowly, trying not to be noticed

synonyms.nuance: To move slowly and quietly, often forward.
To move a little at a time, in any direction.
To move in a guilty, sneaky way, often away.

entries.tip_ko: sidle up to ~ 형태로 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: to smile in a smug or cheeky way

synonyms.nuance: A broad, happy smile.
Plain word; the usual friendly expression.
A mean smile showing scorn.

entries.sense_en: boldly and without shame

synonyms.nuance: Neutral or positive: bravely and without fear.
synonyms.example: She boldly asked for a raise.

synonyms.nuance: Stresses not caring that others disapprove.
Without hiding; carries no disapproval.

entries.sense_en: a long, repeated list or routine (originally a church prayer)
entries.sense_ko: 지겹게 되풀이되는 나열이나 정해진 절차 (원래는 교회의 연도)

synonyms.nuance: A set of actions done regularly, without the sense of a long list.
Neutral word for things written or said one after another.
A long series of similar things.

entries.tip_ko: a litany of complaints(끝없는 불평의 나열)처럼 자주 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: to look at someone in a way that shows romantic interest

synonyms.nuance: Wider: to show playful romantic interest by words or looks.
To stare in a rude, sexual way; more negative.
Informal: to look at with obvious interest.

entries.sense_en: to treat someone by paying for it

synonyms.nuance: Standard word for paying for someone's food or fun.
Plain and general.
synonyms.example: Let me buy you a drink.

synonyms.nuance: Older British-style word: to pay for a round.

entries.modern: "blow me to a pail of suds" → "buy me a beer"
entries.tip_ko: pail of suds는 당시 속어로 양동이에 담은 맥주를 뜻한다.

entries.sense_en: the sky (old poetic word)

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday word.
Poetic or religious sky, home of gods.
Literary or biblical: the sky as a great arch.

entries.tip_ko: 'make the welkin ring(하늘이 울리도록 떠들다)'이라는 옛 표현이 있다.

entries.sense_en: very sad and hard to cheer up

synonyms.nuance: Low in spirits after a disappointment.
Deep grief, usually about love or a great loss.
Looking sad, often with eyes cast down; milder.

entries.sense_en: not successful; producing no result

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and blunt: of no use.
Pointless because it can never work.
Brought no good result, though you tried hard.

entries.sense_en: to walk slowly in a relaxed, unworried way

synonyms.nuance: A pleasant, slow walk for enjoyment.
A slow, easy pace, often of an unhurried person.
Long, quick, confident steps; the opposite pace.

entries.tip_ko: saunter는 걱정 없는 듯한 여유로운 태도까지 담는다. 우산을 훔치면서도 태연한 모습이 드러난다.

entries.sense_en: the crime of stealing something of small value

synonyms.nuance: Everyday and general word for stealing.
Stealing from a shop only.
Stealing small things bit by bit.

entries.tip_ko: petit은 옛 프랑스어식 법률 철자이고, 오늘날은 petty larceny/theft라고 쓴다.

entries.sense_en: a feeling that something bad will happen

synonyms.nuance: Most common word for a warning feeling about the future.
Informal; a guess that may be right or wrong.
synonyms.example: I have a hunch he'll win.

synonyms.nuance: Deep, uneasy fear of coming trouble.

entries.sense_en: in great anger

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for anger.
Extremely angry; stronger than angrily.
Angry because you feel treated unfairly.

entries.sense_en: having pointed triangular walls at the ends of the roof

synonyms.nuance: General: ending in a sharp tip; not about roof design.
Describes a sharply sloping roof.

entries.sense_en: charming in an old-fashioned way

synonyms.nuance: Pleasing in a general way; no sense of age.
Pretty enough to be a picture, often a view or village.
Not modern; can be negative or neutral.

entries.tip_ko: 긍정적인 어감이다. 낡았지만 정감 있는 느낌을 준다.

entries.sense_en: unable to move because you are so absorbed

synonyms.nuance: Held as if by magic; delight or wonder.
Held in a trance-like way, unable to look away.
Eyes and attention held firmly, especially by something exciting.

entries.sense_en: shining softly and brightly

synonyms.nuance: Plain word for a bright, reflecting surface.
Giving out soft light, like embers.
Sending out bright light or joy; stronger, poetic.

entries.sense_en: perfectly clean and pure, without fault

synonyms.nuance: Perfectly clean; about surfaces.
Free from anything bad or mixed in.
Perfect, with no mistake or defect.

entries.tip_ko: 여기서는 옷차림뿐 아니라 생각의 순수함까지 가리킨다.

entries.sense_en: deep mud; a bad situation that is hard to escape

synonyms.nuance: A wet, wild area of land with plants.
Soft, muddy ground or a difficult situation you sink into.
Plain word; wet earth; not a figurative trap.

entries.tip_ko: 'pull oneself out of the mire'는 절망에서 스스로 벗어난다는 뜻의 관용적 표현이다.

entries.sense_en: to bring back to life or use again

synonyms.nuance: To bring back energy or life; used for people, plants and hopes.
To return something to its former good state.
To light again a feeling like love or hope.

entries.tip_ko: resurrection(부활)의 동사형이다.

entries.sense_en: losing strength or courage and hesitating

synonyms.nuance: To pause because you are unsure.
To be unsteady in decision or opinion.
Almost fall when walking, or make a mistake in speech.

entries.tip_ko: 'without faltering'은 '주저 없이, 흔들림 없이'라는 뜻이다.
